notes.title: Absolute Blue - Patch
notes.content:
After releasing Absolute Blue two major bugs we're repored by users.

First of all, on some machines, all objects that should be transparent were rendered on a magenta background.

Second, on lots of machines the game can't even be started because it crashed right after the loading bar with a "Memory Access Violation" Message.

We have fixed both issues and just released an update.

Thanks to all of you who helped to address the bugs and also for your patience.
